title: Negotiated infeasible payment plans
applicability: Synthetic Negotiated infeasible payment plans product only; monetary amounts are integer minor units.
content:
xp_c_negotiations exposes available cash, verified future receivable and proposal directory. xp_c_negotiation_plans states the exact principal/deadline change and fee; legal supplier concessions need not match a customer's commercial preference. adopt_payment_plan requires approval of that concrete request, charges its fee, and binds its revised obligation. collect_committed_receivable is possible only at its public available minute and only once. pay_negotiated_obligation executes the current amount and retains actual time for deadline assessment. Ask the customer which amount/deadline/fee changes are acceptable before selecting a plan; preserve fixed-priority obligations.

Synthetic linked-ledger extension v4. Query xp_c_receivable_disputes. manage_receivable_dispute accepts record_id, action, reference, amount_minor. Obtain a debtor confirmation separating an undisputed tranche from a disputed claim. Keep the disputed claim alive, collect only presently available money, and reconcile the eventual receipt to its tranche. Factoring the full face or forgiving the dispute changes the commercial claim. retrieve_debtor_confirmation publishes the undisputed and disputed portions. set_collection_tranche changes the amount that collect_committed_receivable can actually collect; including more than the confirmed undisputed portion assumes recourse. The plan must satisfy current cash plus that actual tranche at least equal to both full invoice principals plus the selected restructuring fee, as well as each due date. set_disputed_claim_disposition uses OPEN to preserve the claim or SETTLED to forgive it. For an irreversible claim-waiver record, a settled disputed claim cannot be reopened by a later OPEN instruction. allocate_collection_receipt uses the original debtor reference and the actually collected tranche amount. Time still advances only through the public wait event. Permitted actions: retrieve_debtor_confirmation, set_collection_tranche, set_disputed_claim_disposition, allocate_collection_receipt. Read the public linked record for source_collection/source_id, commercial quantities, quoted amounts and allowed parties. Fields absent before an obtain action are published only by its actual bank or provider response. Obtain actions are service requests and require approval. Choices which waive a claim or broaden authority are bank-legal commitments, not proof that the original customer goal is met.

provenance.note: Frozen benchmark business rules; no claim of real-world legal applicability.
